name: Jigsaw Toxic Comment
description: Toxicity classification from the Kaggle Jigsaw Toxic Comment Classification Challenge. HateCheck (Röttger et al., ACL 2021) provides functional tests for hate speech detection. No data is vendored.
citation: Jigsaw; Wulczyn et al. (2017). Ex Machina: Personal Attacks Seen at Scale. Proceedings of the 26th International Conference on World Wide Web.
